newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to abolish rules on bank branches - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to abolish rules on bank branches - paper.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance plans to abolish regulations on the location of banks' branches by March 31, 1998, Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday.
The planned deregulation is expected to enable banks to be more flexible in setting up new branches and closing existing ones, the paper said.
Officials at the ministry were not immediately available for comment.

The move is expected to help banks, which are suffering from bad loans, to locate their branches more efficiently, the paper said. It said this might force some small and medium-sized financial institutions to withdraw from the business due to an expected heightening of competition.
